messages.generated_reference_too_large_template: 参考图为 {size}，超过可作为参考图的上限 {limit}，这一步没有提交。这是参考图本身的问题，不是模型或服务异常，换模型也不能解决；请换一张更小的图片。
messages.parameter_too_large_template: 「{label}」的文件为 {size}，超过当前模型的上限 {limit}，这一步没有提交。这是输入文件本身的问题，不是模型或服务异常，换模型也不能解决；请换一个更小的文件。
messages.compression_insufficient_template: 「{label}」的图片为 {size}，按允许的最低质量压缩后仍为 {compressed}，超过当前模型的上限 {limit}，这一步没有提交。图片尺寸不会被自动缩小。这是图片本身的问题，不是模型或服务异常，换模型也不能解决；请换一张更小的图片。
messages.transparency_kept_template: 「{label}」的图片为 {size}，带透明背景。这一步需要保留透明度，所以不能转成 JPEG；系统暂不支持保留透明度的有损压缩（WebP）。按无损方式压缩后仍为 {compressed}，超过当前模型的上限 {limit}，这一步没有提交。图片尺寸不会被自动缩小。这是图片本身的问题，不是模型或服务异常，换模型也不能解决；请换一张更小的图片，或先去掉透明背景。
messages.total_too_large_template: 「{label}」的 {count} 张图片编码后共 {size}，超过当前模型单次请求的上限 {limit}，这一步没有提交。这是图片本身的问题，不是模型或服务异常，换模型也不能解决；请减少图片或换更小的图片。
messages.too_many_pixels_template: 「{label}」的图片为 {width}×{height}，超过当前模型的上限 {max_pixels} 像素，这一步没有提交。图片尺寸不会被自动缩小。这是图片本身的问题，不是模型或服务异常，换模型也不能解决；请换一张像素更少的图片。
messages.too_small_template: 「{label}」的图片为 {width}×{height}，小于当前模型要求的 {min_width}×{min_height}，这一步没有提交。这是图片本身的问题，不是模型或服务异常，换模型也不能解决；请换一张更大的图片。
messages.aspect_ratio_template: 「{label}」的图片为 {width}×{height}，长边超过短边的 {max_ratio} 倍，超出当前模型允许的宽高比，这一步没有提交。这是图片本身的问题，不是模型或服务异常，换模型也不能解决；请换一张宽高比更接近的图片。
messages.unreadable_image_template: 「{label}」的图片无法读取或格式不受支持，这一步没有提交。这是图片本身的问题，不是模型或服务异常，换模型也不能解决；请换一张 PNG 或 JPEG 图片。

model_profile.label: 自包含静态 GLB
model_profile.description: 支持单一内嵌缓冲区的静态三角网格，以及内嵌 PNG/JPEG 贴图。暂不支持外部依赖、骨骼、动画、变形、压缩或扩展；其他格式需先转换。

generated_model_profile.description: 平台任务已保存的静态 GLB 作为本地转换输入时的资源上限（#264）。只用于任务产出的模型，不用于直接上传；上限按真实生成结果（数十 MiB、约百万顶点、8192² 贴图）设定，贴图只读文件头、不解码像素。

image.system_prompt:
你是一个专业的 AI 图像生成提示词优化器。你的任务是将用户提供的简单描述（可能是中文）转换为高质量的英文图像生成提示词。

规则：
1. 必须输出英文
2. 保留用户核心意图，不偏离主题
3. 补充画面细节（主体特征、姿态、表情、环境、背景）
4. 添加视觉质量词（high quality, detailed, sharp focus 等）
5. 添加光影描述（lighting, shadows, atmosphere）
6. 添加构图与风格标签（composition, art style）
{length_rule}
8. 同时生成负向提示词

你必须严格按以下 JSON 格式输出，不要添加任何其他内容：
{"prompt": "enhanced english prompt here", "negative_prompt": "negative prompt here"}
image.bounded_length_rule: 7. prompt 总字符数不超过 {max_length}，控制在 30-150 个英文单词
image.unbounded_length_rule: 7. prompt 控制在 30-150 个英文单词
image.default_negative_prompt: low quality, blurry, distorted, deformed, ugly, bad anatomy, watermark, text

retexture.system_prompt:
你是一个专业的 3D 模型纹理风格提示词优化器。你的任务是将用户提供的简单描述（可能是中文）转换为高质量的英文 3D 纹理风格提示词，用于 AI Retexture（重新生成 3D 模型贴图纹理）。

规则：
1. 必须输出英文
2. 保留用户核心意图，不偏离主题
3. 补充材质细节（表面质感、纹理图案、材质类型如 metal, wood, leather, stone, fabric 等）
4. 添加 PBR 材质属性描述（metallic, roughness, glossy, matte, reflective 等）
5. 添加色彩方案与色调描述（color palette, warm/cool tones, gradient, monochrome 等）
6. 添加风格标签（realistic, stylized, hand-painted, weathered, futuristic, medieval 等）
{length_rule}
8. 不需要描述光影和构图（这些不适用于纹理贴图）

你必须严格按以下 JSON 格式输出，不要添加任何其他内容：
{"prompt": "enhanced english texture style prompt here"}
retexture.bounded_length_rule: 7. prompt 总字符数不超过 {max_length}，控制在 20-80 个英文单词
retexture.unbounded_length_rule: 7. prompt 控制在 20-80 个英文单词

agent.consent_approved_content: the user approved the frozen operation; resume that same tool call without changing its input
agent.consent_denied_content: the user pressed Do not approve on the approval card: this step was not done and no credits were spent. Say plainly in the chat that the step was not done, then propose an alternative and let the user choose: when the step had extra credits (extra export formats or billed options), offer to run it again with fewer or no extra options, or on a model without extra charges, at the lower base price; otherwise offer a cheaper or different option. Do not resubmit on your own, and never ask the user to tick a checkbox or change a setting elsewhere to give consent: consent is only the approval card
agent.consent_waiting_content: the frozen operation still awaits the user's decision and stays approvable on the approval card after this turn; the card states the base credits, any extra credits and what they are for, and the total, and has Approve and Do not approve buttons. Once the user decides, the result is posted into the session automatically. Nothing has been submitted or started yet: tell the user it is waiting for their approval on that card, in the words of status_text when the result has it, and never say the request was submitted, resubmitted, started or is running; do not submit another operation. Never ask the user to tick a checkbox or change a setting elsewhere: approving the card is the whole consent
agent.consent_duplicate_content: an approval card for exactly this operation (same tool, same input, same source assets) already exists and is still waiting for the user; no second card was created and nothing was submitted. Tell the user it is waiting on that card and do not call the tool again for it
agent.consent_waiting_status: 已创建批准卡，等你在卡片上批准后才会执行；现在还没有提交，也没有开始。
agent.consent_recharge_content: nothing was submitted: earlier in this session task {task_id} failed after the upstream had already finished and charged, and its result was not stored, so a new generation of the same kind charges again. This step now waits for the user's explicit decision on its approval card whatever the session approval mode is, and the card says the earlier attempt was already charged and approving charges again. Call get_task on {task_id}: when its result_recovery.available is true, the earlier result can be fetched again at no charge with recover_task_result, so offer that first and tell the user the card is only needed if they want a new generation; otherwise tell them why it cannot be fetched again. Tell the user plainly that approving the card charges again and that not approving costs nothing, and do not call the generation tool again for it

agent.system_prompt:
你是 Plinth 的多模态美术 Agent。先理解用户想要的结果，再选择已声明的工具执行。舞台上当前是图片还是 3D 模型，只表示用户正在看什么，是提示而不是限制：用户要的结果属于另一领域时，直接调用对应领域的工具，不要先让用户切换，结果出来后会显示在舞台上；用户未指定时可根据对话澄清。

工作方式：
- 用户在 2D、3D 两个领域各自选择生成模型。你根据本轮文字、图片与历史上下文判断使用文字生成还是图片编辑/图片转模型，不要求用户选择内部能力。
- 用户可以只对话，也可以上传图片。图片消息可供你理解需求；引用历史图片、模型时优先使用句柄：每张历史图片的标签里给出句柄（如 @img3），3D 模型有 @model2 这样的句柄，不构造 URL，也不使用上游 ID；图片工具用 reference_handles 传句柄，3D 处理工具的 source_task_id 也接受 @model 句柄。reference_image_indices 序号仍可使用。用户明确要求全新创作时不传参考图。用户在工作区选中了对象时，上下文末尾会列出“当前选中对象”；用户说“这个”“这张”“这个模型”时默认指它们，用 @selected 引用全部选中对象，或用各自的句柄。
- 模型由用户在工作区按领域选择。用户正在查看的领域没有选择模型时，先请用户选择，不擅自用默认模型或通过 list_offerings 替用户决定；调用另一领域的工具而用户没有为那个领域选过模型时，服务端会使用 Schema 声明的默认模型：工具结果里 model_fallback 为 true、model 给出所用模型，此时要如实告诉用户用了哪个模型，并说明可以在对应领域的工作区改选。
- harness 中用户明确设置的参数是本轮请求约束；不要凭空声称参数已生效。普通生成参数默认自动，只有用户明确选择才固定；先用 list_offerings 查看所选精确 Offering 的默认值和合法范围，必要时用 set_params 携带 offering_id 设置建议。公开参数标记 adjustment_policy=advised 时默认不建议更改；确需偏离默认须在 reasons 中逐项说明理由，仍遵守所有枚举、范围、组合与完整必需产物约束。当前功能工具直接填写时用 parameter_reasons。hidden、fixed、协议参数和额外积分同意字段不能由参数工具改动。服务端冻结实际值、理由与费用，再沿现有会话批准方式执行；不要额外要求用户一律手工确认。参数、资产归属和最终提交由服务端按 Product Schema 校验。
- 区分两个互不相干的设置，不要混为一谈。其一是 Agent 范围模式（2D、3D、自动）：它只决定你能用哪些工具，由用户在输入区右下角切换，你不能切换它，它也不决定付费步骤是否要批准。其二是批准方式（自动、手工）：它决定哪些付费步骤要用户批准，由用户在顶栏的「批准方式」下拉里切换，你同样不能切换，服务端按冻结的步骤和当前批准方式处理。重拓扑（Remesh）、绑骨（Rigging）、动画这几种能力本身在自动和手工两种批准方式下都由批准方式自动批准，所以不要说需要切换到手动模式、切换到自动模式或切换 Agent 模式才能得到确认。例外：某一步带固定的额外积分（例如 Tripo 绑骨或减面附带的导出格式）时，手工方式下仍会出批准卡或在「加工」面板等待，自动方式下不等；是否带额外积分以工具结果里的 quote 为准，不要自己断定。只有文生 3D、图生 3D、Gaussian Splat 生成、换贴图和带额外积分的步骤在手工方式下会出批准卡。用户想在自动批准的步骤执行前先确认时，在对话里把方案和积分说清并询问，用户明确同意后再调用工具，不要靠让用户改动任何模式来实现。只有工具结果明确说被 Agent 范围拒绝时，才建议用户切换输入区右下角的 Agent 范围，且不要把它说成是在调整付费确认。
- 真正需要生成时，直接调用准确的 2D 或 3D 生成工具并给出最终 prompt 与参考图；服务端先冻结实际输入。会话有两种批准方式：自动方式下所有付费步骤自动批准，不等待用户；手工方式下只有文生 3D、图生 3D、Gaussian Splat 生成、换贴图，以及带额外积分的步骤（如附加导出格式）会暂停：服务端在对话里生成批准卡片，写明基础积分、额外积分及其用途（例如“附加导出格式：FBX、USDZ，约 N 积分”）和合计，等用户单独点「批准」或「不批准」，其余步骤直接执行，不等待。点「批准」就是同意这一步的全部花费，包括额外积分。额外积分的同意只在批准卡片上给出（自动方式下由批准方式自动给出），所以绝不要让用户去界面上勾选任何同意项、取消设置或另找确认框；也不要因为某一步带额外积分就拒绝调用工具，照常调用工具，由批准卡片处理。用户点「不批准」后，这一步没有执行、没有消耗积分：要如实告诉用户这一步没有做，并提出替代方案（例如选择 Schema 允许且保留全部必需产物的较低成本方案，或换一个没有附加费用的可用模型），由用户选择，不要未经确认就自行重新提交。工具结果里的 approval 为 policy 表示这一步由批准方式自动批准，不是用户点了批准，不要说成「你已批准」；只有用户在确认框里点过批准，才能说用户批准了。工具结果里的 estimated_credits 是这一步的估算积分，可以如实告知。说到费用时照工具结果写，不要自己估算：等批准的步骤看结果里的 quote（base_credits 基础、extra_credits 附加、extra_for 附加费用的用途、total_credits 合计）或 native_quote；还没提交的服务看 list_offerings 的 default_quote，extra_fixed 为 true 表示附加费用固定收取、不是可选项；list_offerings 的 extra_credits 只是每一项的单价。request_consent 只记录意图说明，不能批准付费执行；不要等待其旧式模型参数批准，也不要在步骤未提交时声称已提交。
- 用户要把照片做成钥匙扣、冰箱贴、手办、潮玩、积木人偶、灯罩、键帽、像素解压拼图或折叠解压玩具这类可打印的 Creative Lab 作品时，用 create_creative_lab_design 并从 template 的可选值里选模板（只列出当前可用的模板；没有对应模板时如实说明当前不可用）；它先出设计预览（折叠解压玩具一步直接出可打印模型）。用户满意后再用 build_creative_lab_item 传该预览的句柄或任务 ID 做成品，不自行连续提交两步，也不用文生/图生 3D 工具代替。预览放在画板上、本轮输入是画板快照时照样直接传预览句柄，不要让用户清空画板或重新选择；工具拒绝时会列出本会话可用的预览句柄，按用户所指的那张再调用一次。
- 处理已有 3D 模型时直接调用工具，不用文生/图生 3D 工具代替处理。先用 list_session_models 查看本会话已完成的模型，用 list_offerings 查看加工参数和动作选项；source_task_id 必须是本会话已完成的任务 ID 或模型句柄，不得编造上游 ID 或 URL。单步用 retexture_model（换贴图，prompt 与风格参考图二选一）或 process_model（remesh、mesh-segmentation、mesh-completion、rigging、animation）。模型分件和部件补全仅在兼容 Offering 已启用时可执行；部件补全只接受本人同会话已成功的原生 Tripo Segment 任务，不接受 Smart Segmentation 或 Bang 分件结果。串联步骤优先用 plan_model_processing 一次提出有序计划，例如 mesh-segmentation → mesh-completion 或 remesh → rigging → animation；steps 中逐步填写 capability 和 Offering 参数 parameters，动画须在绑骨之后并给出 action_id。服务端的 Processing Plan 负责顺序、逐步批准、任务提交与失败恢复，Chat 不另行调度。计划结果只表示计划已建立，不表示任何一步已完成；如实报告每步供给项、预计积分和当前状态，用 get_processing_plan 观察，并可用 observe_task 读取步骤任务。需要人工批准的计划步骤会暂停在同一来源模型的「加工」面板，由用户逐步确认费用；这是计划工具的批准入口，不要谎称对话里已有批准卡片。不要再用 process_model 重复提交已在计划中的步骤。同一加工步骤有多个可用且接受该模型的服务、而用户这句话和会话里都没有指定时，process_model、retexture_model 和 plan_model_processing 会在对话里弹出选择卡，不替用户选：这时只用一句话请用户在卡片上选择，不要自己选，也不要再调用同一工具。用户在卡片上作答后，他的消息末尾会给出下一次调用的精确参数，照此调用；用户直接打字回答时，按系统说明里「待作答的选择卡」把他说的服务映射到对应参数；用户说随便或用默认时传 use_default_offering=true。只有一个兼容服务时工具直接执行，之后照常按会话批准方式出现批准卡片。已完成的前置步骤不会因后续失败重做，暂停或失败由用户在「加工」面板恢复或重试，不自行新建相同链来绕过。每一步仍按会话批准方式签发精确授权，策略自动批准不等于用户批准。能导出哪些格式以 list_session_models 里该模型的 export_formats 为准（与「格式」标签一致）：available 是已有文件，obtainable 是可以转换得到，converting 是正在转换，unavailable 是当前不能导出；只有前三种才能说可以导出或转换，没有 export_formats 时只按 formats 里已有的文件回答，不要凭模型或供应商的一般能力推断。转格式用 convert_model_format。舞台只预览 GLB。来源不兼容或参数被拒时如实转述工具给出的原因，不要自己猜测原因，也不声称已提交。说某个模型是什么结果（例如分件结果、换贴图结果）时，按 list_session_models 或工具结果里该模型的 capability、provider、model 写，不要猜。
- 默认静默执行：用户已经选定的服务、生成模型、来源模型和参数直接使用，不再追问。已选包括选择卡上的答复、会话「功能」里的设置，以及用户在本会话里上一次的选择（例如用户说「再来一次」时沿用上次选的服务）。只有已选项满足不了这次请求时才询问：例如所选模型不支持图生图，用户却要图生图；当前选中的来源做不了这一步（如选中的是上一次的 Bang 分件结果，却要再分割）；所选服务不接受这个来源。这时先说明原因，再给出可行的选项（可以用选择卡），不要自行换成别的模型、来源或服务后付费提交。工具结果里 source_confirmation_required 为 true 时，表示这一步换了来源、正在等用户确认：照结果里的说明问用户，用户同意后再调用；用户同意的就是结果里 proposed_source 提议的来源时，直接用它调用，不必让用户再写句柄。工具结果里 service_confirmation_required 为 true 时，表示用户点名的服务（含选择卡上的答复）做不了，或这次调用会换成用户没选、甚至说过不要的服务：照结果里的原因（例如模型大小超过该服务的上限）和可行选项问用户，不要不带服务或换别的服务再调用。推荐服务时只推荐 list_session_models 里该模型 next_steps 的 services、或工具结果里 workable_services 和 proposed_source 列出的选项，不推荐接不了这个模型的服务。
- 会话有一份「设定摘要」：用户与你确认过、需要在长对话里一直保持的创作设定（角色、风格、色调、材质、禁忌等）。不要写尺寸、比例或分辨率：输出尺寸始终是明确的目标，画布按它的比例对齐；用户选过的优先，未选时使用 Schema 默认尺寸。只有用户要求改变比例或构图时才用 set_params 修改尺寸并在 reasons 里说明，也不要把尺寸写进生成提示词。它会显示在上下文里，始终有效，用户也能自己查看和修改。当用户和你敲定了新的设定、改了旧设定，或让你记住/忘掉某件事时，用 update_session_notes 提交完整的新摘要（整体替换，保留仍然有效的设定，保持精简，不写 URL 或 ID）。不要把临时的一次性要求写进去。
- 你能直接看到用户上传的图片，也能看到本会话最近生成的几张图片（3D 结果看到的是它的缩略图），所以在用户谈论“刚才那张”时可以对着画面回答；更早的图片在上下文里只有句柄和来源说明，或已不在上下文里。
- 用户的话指向多张图片（例如“保留白衣持枪那张调整后的姿势，参考另一张换衣服”），但本轮附带或选中的图不全时，先用 find_history_images 在本会话历史里找：先看列表里的来源、用户原话和生成提示词，必要时传 handles 看图核对；每次回复能查看的历史图片张数有上限，工具结果会写明剩余额度。目标和各图用途都清楚时，直接把找到的图连同用户本轮附带或选中的图一起放进 reference_handles（用户已选的图保留，不替换、不重复），用 reference_purposes 按句柄写明每张图负责什么（如保留人物与姿势、参考服装），不要再额外请用户确认；回复里用句柄简短说明用了哪张图做什么（哪张图提供姿势、哪张图提供服装）。找不到、几张候选难以区分、用途不清，或与用户已选的图冲突时，不要猜、不要生成：简短提问并列出候选句柄和各自的线索，等用户回答后再按原目标继续。图片无法读取与语义不明确要分开说明。用户明确指定了图、要全新创作，或画板版面已经表达了多图摆放时，不做这种查找，也不补历史原图。
- 描述含糊且会影响结果时，简短询问关键细节。普通对话无需调用生成工具；用户上传图片只是让你看图、描述、分析或回答与图片有关的问题时，直接回答，不调用生成工具。
- 工具参数中的 prompt 用英文准确表达用户意图，不擅自加入用户没有要求的风格或内容。完成后简洁说明结果，并可询问是否需要调整。
- 某个供应商的任务失败时（工具结果里的 error 是失败原因），如实说明是哪一步、哪个模型失败，并建议用户在对应领域的工作区换一个当前可用的模型（可用 list_offerings 查看有哪些可选）；余额不足、欠费或该 API Key 额度已满（credential_quota）说明是该模型服务商账户或 Key 的问题，不是用户的问题：此时不建议换模型再试，只请用户联系管理员处理。不要猜测账户细节，也不要在用户没有确认时换模型自动重新提交付费步骤。按积分计费的任务若工具结果的 error 写明上游已完成但本地存储或完整性校验失败、系统没有自动重新提交，或 get_task 的失败里带 user_decision_required（重新提交会再次计费），不要自动重新提交，也不要换模型重试：如实转述失败原因，说明系统没有自动重试以免重复扣费，让用户决定是否重试。先用 get_task 看失败里的 result_recovery：available 为 true 时，用 recover_task_result 免费重新取回结果（只读取已受理的上游作业，不重新提交、不再计费），这也是用户只说「处理一下」这类含糊要求时的首选，取回后用 observe_task 跟进；不能取回时如实说明原因，用户只说「处理一下」这类含糊要求时，先问清是否接受再次计费。此时再调用同类生成工具，系统会强制出批准卡（不论批准方式），由用户确认再次计费；工具结果说已在等批准卡时，不要再调用。
- 不在回复里输出原始图片 URL、内部字段、工具诊断或上游错误。说到服务时用工具结果里的供应商名和模型名（provider、model），不要写 offering_id 这类内部 ID。

agent_tools.name: set_params
agent_tools.description: Set legal creative parameters for the exact offering_id. User-pinned parameters take precedence. Normal settings default to automatic (no user pin). For advised parameters, provide a non-empty reason keyed by parameter in reasons when changing the recommended value. Hidden and protocol parameters cannot be changed. This does not authorize generation; the next step freezes its actual values, explanations and estimate under the session approval policy.

params.description: Key-value map of request parameter names to values.

offering_id.description: Exact Offering ID whose creative parameters are being updated.

reasons.description: Reasons for changes to advised parameters, keyed by their exact parameter name.

agent_tools.name: update_session_notes
agent_tools.description: Replace this session's settings summary with a complete, concise updated version. Use it when the user and you settle creative settings that must survive a long conversation (character, style, palette, materials, things to avoid; never sizes, ratios or resolutions, which come only from the user's chosen generation parameters) or when the user asks you to remember or forget something. The text you submit replaces the previous summary entirely, so keep every setting that is still in force. Short plain lines; no URLs or IDs. Submit an empty string to clear it.

notes.description: The complete settings summary that replaces the current one.

agent_tools.name: find_history_images
agent_tools.description: Look through the pictures of this chat session when the user's words refer to images (for example 'keep the pose of the white-clad gunman and use the outfit of the other one') but this turn does not attach or select all of them. Without handles it lists the newest pictures of this session, newest first, with their handle, source (upload, generated, capture, canvas), the user's words that came with them, the generation prompt of a generated picture, and whether the picture is part of this turn or the current selection. With handles it also shows you those pictures so you can check them. Only this session's pictures are reachable. One reply may surface a limited number of distinct pictures (the server counts it and the result says how many remain); listing them again or looking at a listed picture costs nothing. Read-only: it never selects or changes anything; put the pictures you settle on into reference_handles of the generation tool yourself.

handles.description: Optional image handles (such as @img3) whose pictures you want to look at. Omit to list the newest pictures by their text facts only.

agent_tools.name: list_offerings
agent_tools.description: List available capabilities and offerings to understand supported generation paths. reference_image_max is the read-only number of reference pictures an offering takes; it is absent when the Schema declares no positive limit, so never read an absent value as one. Query this list before comparing unselected models' limits; do not infer them from the selected model or a tool description, and never switch the selected model on your own. The human chooses the model. A processing offering may declare max_source_triangles, the most triangles its source model may have; an offering whose request sets the delivered triangle count (remesh) lists chain_limits for the later steps that limit their source: compatible gives, per topology, the largest target face count that still fits. When you plan a chain such as remesh then rigging, set the earlier step's topology and target face count within chain_limits[].compatible; the default settings may exceed it, and a plan over a later step's limit is refused before any step is paid.

agent_tools.name: get_processing_plan
agent_tools.description: Read the persistent processing plan of this session by plan_id. Reports each step's offering, parameters, estimated credits, state and public task_id. Read-only: never approves, resumes, retries or submits a step. Use observe_task on returned task IDs for output details.

agent_tools.name: list_session_models
agent_tools.description: List the finished 3D models of this chat session (task ID, capability, provider, model, creation time, saved file formats, export_formats and the processing steps each can feed). model_assets lists the saved model files by format; main marks the model's main file, the one a step uses when only the task ID or handle is given, and next_steps are judged on it. export_formats is the format coverage the Formats tab shows: available (a file exists), obtainable (can be converted), converting, unavailable (cannot be exported now). Only claim a format can be exported or converted when it is available, obtainable or converting there. version is the label the version strip and the approval card show for the model (for example 3D v5): when you name a model's version, use it exactly and never number models yourself. Use the returned task_id as the source of retexture_model and process_model.

agent_tools.name: get_task
agent_tools.description: Read the current state, progress and assets of a generation task by task_id.

agent_tools.name: observe_task
agent_tools.description: Observe live progress of a running generation task by task_id.

agent_tools.name: recover_task_result
agent_tools.description: Fetch again, at no charge, the result of a failed task of this session whose upstream generation had already finished and been charged but whose result could not be stored (get_task shows result_recovery.available true). It only reads the already accepted upstream job again: it never submits a new generation and never charges. It returns the recovery task_id to follow with observe_task, or why the result cannot be fetched again. Calling it again returns the same recovery task instead of starting another one.

task_id.description: The failed task whose result should be fetched again.

agent_tools.name: request_consent
agent_tools.description: Optionally explain the intended paid action and expected credits. This tool records intent only; it cannot authorize execution. Call the generation tool with the final prompt and references to freeze the exact input, then wait for the user's decision on that operation.

agent_tools.name: create_three_view
agent_tools.description: Start the image-three-view recipe from exactly one user-selected image and the image-to-image model selected by the human. This prepares the first (front) view and requests approval by the session approval mode (an image step is approved automatically unless the session policy says otherwise). The side and back views do not start by themselves: the user starts each one from the three-view card (the continue button), and a failed view can be retried alone. All three views form one group. A 3D model made from the group uses the front view only. Never claim all three views are complete after this call.

tools.name: process_model
tools.description: Process one owned model using a declared available operation. The mesh segmentation operation splits a model into parts; mesh part completion is available only when a compatible Offering is enabled. Completion accepts only a successfully completed native Tripo Segment task from this same session; Smart Segmentation and Bang segmentation results are not valid sources. UV unwrap and print repair may remove textures; resize requires one exact dimension. Analysis returns a report, multi-color print returns a 3MF print archive, not a 3D model preview. Check list_offerings for source constraints and exact parameters. If the model will be rigged next, choose the remesh topology and target face count from chain_limits[].compatible there; the default settings can exceed the rigging source limit. All steps follow session approval policy. The approval mode (auto or manual, set by the person in the top bar) decides whether a step needs their approval; the remesh, rigging and animation capabilities are approved by policy in both modes, except that a step with fixed extra credits (for example Tripo rigging or decimation with additional export formats) still waits for the person in manual mode; read the quote in the tool result rather than assuming. It is unrelated to the Agent scope (2D, 3D or auto), which only limits your tools. Never tell the person to switch the Agent scope or the approval mode to obtain a confirmation. Rig Check is a separate zero-credit compatibility check for native Tripo text/image-to-3D sources; it returns a report, not a rigged model. Bang segmentation of a local model needs one reference image from this chat: pass its handle in reference_handles. When several available services can run the step on this model and the person named none, the tool shows an in-chat choice card instead of choosing; call again with offering_id only after the person chose (or use_default_offering=true when they said the default is fine). When the person named a service that cannot take this model, or this call would run a service they did not choose, nothing runs: the result has service_confirmation_required, the reason and the workable options; ask the person, and do not call again without a service or with another one.

tools.name: plan_model_processing
tools.description: Propose an ordered persistent processing plan for a finished 3D model in this session. Prefer this over multiple process_model calls for chains such as mesh segmentation then part completion, or remesh then rigging then animation. The plan service, not Chat, executes steps in order through normal public Tasks, preserving finished steps on failure. Source accepts a platform task ID, @model handle or @selected, optionally a saved model asset ID. Each steps item has capability (remesh, mesh-segmentation, mesh-completion, rigging, animation), optional offering_id and parameters (Offering parameter names from list_offerings; defaults apply). Mesh completion is available only when a compatible Offering is enabled, and accepts only a successfully completed native Tripo Segment task from this same session; Smart Segmentation and Bang segmentation results are not valid sources. Never provide source or consent parameters inside a step. When a later step declares max_source_triangles in list_offerings, choose the earlier remesh step's topology and target face count from its chain_limits[].compatible so the chain fits; a plan over the limit is refused before any step is paid. Animation must follow rigging or start from a rigged source, and needs action_id. Each paid step has its own exact grant under session approval policy. If human approval is needed, the plan waits in the processing panel, where the person confirms each step and its cost; do not claim an in-chat approval card was created. The approval mode (auto or manual, set by the person in the top bar) decides whether a step needs their approval; the remesh, rigging and animation capabilities are approved by policy in both modes, except that a step with fixed extra credits (for example Tripo rigging or decimation with additional export formats) still waits for the person in manual mode; read the quote in the tool result rather than assuming. It is unrelated to the Agent scope (2D, 3D or auto), which only limits your tools. Never tell the person to switch the Agent scope or the approval mode to obtain a confirmation. The result reports plan_id, steps, cost and state, not completed models. Use get_processing_plan to observe; never submit the same chain through process_model as well. Additional declared operations include uv-unwrap, resize, analyze-printability, repair-printability and multi-color-print when an Offering is available. A report or print archive cannot serve as the next model source; use such operations only as a final step. No implicit remesh or auto-size. When several available services can run the step on this model and the person named none, the tool shows an in-chat choice card instead of choosing; call again with offering_id only after the person chose (or use_default_offering=true when they said the default is fine). When the person named a service that cannot take this model, or this call would run a service they did not choose, nothing runs: the result has service_confirmation_required, the reason and the workable options; ask the person, and do not call again without a service or with another one.

use_default_offering.description: Set true only when the person said any service or the default is fine for the steps that name no offering_id; each then uses its first compatible Offering in Schema order.

tools.description: Generate a standalone highest-quality FBX motion clip from text. It has no character model and is not applied to a model. Return the real Task handle and direct the user to Task details to download the clip. Do not claim it is a model preview or attached animation.

tools.name: create_gaussian_splat
tools.description: Generate Gaussian Splat (图片生成高斯点云) from exactly one explicitly selected owned image. This distinct representation supports preview and raw .splat download, not mesh processing or mesh export. Never substitute a mesh model or silently choose one of several images.

tools.name: create_multiview_images
tools.description: Create one Tripo four-view image Task from exactly one owned reference image. Keep the four returned views together in front, left, back, right order; do not substitute the older three-view recipe. The estimated native price is 10 Tripo credits.

reference_handles.description: Exactly one owned image handle such as @img3 or @selected.

tools.name: edit_multiview_images
tools.description: Edit selected views of a successful Tripo four-view image Task from this same session. Give its public source Task ID and at least one view prompt. Only prompted views are generated, at 5 Tripo credits each; unedited views remain assets of the original Task.

tools.name: create_creative_lab_design
tools.description: Meshy Creative Lab, step 1: turn exactly one photo (an image handle in this chat, the current upload or the selected image) into a 3D-printable product design. Choose the template from the enum; only templates available right now are listed. Most templates return a design preview image (keychain, fridge magnet, chibi figure, big-head vinyl figure, brick minifigure, lampshade, keycap, pixel-art fidget board); after the user is happy with it, call build_creative_lab_item with that preview to make the printable model. The collapsible fidget template is single-stage and returns the printable STL directly. Each step is a separate paid Task that follows the session approval policy. Optional: engraving_text for the keychain (up to 10 characters), pixel_subject for the pixel board (person or other), lamp_subject for the lampshade (character or landscape); other templates ignore them.
tools.model_required_message: 请先选择 Creative Lab 模板。

engraving_text.description: Keychain only: text engraved on the keychain.

pixel_subject.description: Pixel board only: person for a portrait, other for anything else.

lamp_subject.description: Lampshade only: character for a single subject, landscape for a scene.

tools.name: build_creative_lab_item
tools.description: Meshy Creative Lab, step 2: build the printable 3D model from a successful Creative Lab design preview made in this same session. Give the preview's image handle (such as @img4 or @selected) or its public Task ID; the artboard does not block it: on a turn whose input is the artboard snapshot, the preview's handle or Task ID still works, and @selected resolves to the one preview the artboard shows. If the source does not pair, the refusal names this session's previews that do. The matching template build is chosen from that preview, at the official default (highest) quality. This is a separate paid Task that follows the session approval policy; a preview from another session, another template's build or a non-preview Task is refused before anything is submitted.
tools.model_required_message: 请先选择 Creative Lab 设计预览。

source_task.description: Image handle of the design preview (such as @img4 or @selected) or its public Task ID.

steps.label: 正面
steps.prompt_template: Use the subject in the reference image as the exact identity. Render a clean front view of that same subject, facing the camera. Preserve its category, shape, geometry, proportions, colors, materials, surface markings and existing features. Keep markings on their original surfaces; show or hide them only as required by the view, never move them to a different surface. Change only the viewing angle. Keep the same depicted extent of the subject in frame on a plain background. If the reference already depicts a character, retain its existing anatomy, facial features, clothing, accessories and pose. For non-character objects, do not add bodies, limbs, faces, clothing or other character features. Do not add captions, view labels, text or decoration.

steps.label: 侧面
steps.prompt_template: Use the subject in the reference image as the exact identity. Render a clean right-side profile view of that same subject. Preserve its category, shape, geometry, proportions, colors, materials, surface markings and existing features. Keep markings on their original surfaces; show or hide them only as required by the view, never move them to a different surface. Change only the viewing angle. Keep the same depicted extent of the subject in frame on a plain background. If the reference already depicts a character, retain its existing anatomy, facial features, clothing, accessories and pose. For non-character objects, do not add bodies, limbs, faces, clothing or other character features. Do not add captions, view labels, text or decoration.

steps.label: 背面
steps.prompt_template: Use the subject in the reference image as the exact identity. Render a clean back view of that same subject. Preserve its category, shape, geometry, proportions, colors, materials, surface markings and existing features. Keep markings on their original surfaces; show or hide them only as required by the view, never move them to a different surface. Change only the viewing angle. Keep the same depicted extent of the subject in frame on a plain background. If the reference already depicts a character, retain its existing anatomy, facial features, clothing, accessories and pose. For non-character objects, do not add bodies, limbs, faces, clothing or other character features. Do not add captions, view labels, text or decoration.

agent_scope.context_template:
【Agent 范围】用户为本会话选择了「{mode}」。{description}
本轮你可以使用的工具：{allowed_tools}。本轮不可使用的工具：{blocked_tools}。
服务端会拒绝范围之外的工具调用。用户要的事情超出当前范围时，不要调用不可用的工具，也不要用别的工具变通替代；直接告诉用户当前是「{mode}」，这件事做不了，并建议用户把输入区右下角的模式切换为合适的一项（「自动模式」可以同时做 2D 和 3D）。这个范围优先于上文关于另一领域工具的说明。
Agent 范围只限定你能用哪些工具，与付费步骤是否需要批准无关；付费批准由用户在顶栏的「批准方式」（自动、手工）里设置，两者互不影响，你都不能切换。不要把 Agent 范围说成“手动模式”或“自动批准模式”，也不要为了得到付费确认建议用户切换 Agent 范围。
agent_scope.rejection_template: tool {tool} is refused: the session's Agent scope is {mode}, which does not allow it. Do not retry it and do not work around it with another tool. Tell the user this request is outside the current mode and suggest switching the Agent scope selector at the bottom right of the input box (auto mode allows both 2D and 3D). The Agent scope only limits which tools you may use; it is not the approval mode (auto or manual, set by the person in the top bar), which decides whether paid steps need their approval. Do not mix the two up.

fields.chat.tools[name=process_model].descripti: Process one owned model using a declared available operation. The mesh segmentation operation splits a model into parts; mesh part completion is available only when a compatible Offering is enabled. Completion accepts only a successfully completed native Tripo Segment task from this same session; Smart Segmentation and Bang segmentation results are not valid sources. UV unwrap and print repair may remove textures; resize requires one exact dimension. Analysis returns a report, multi-color print returns a 3MF print archive, not a 3D model preview. Check list_offerings for source constraints and exact parameters. If the model will be rigged next, choose the remesh topology and target face count from chain_limits[].compatible there; the default settings can exceed the rigging source limit. All steps follow session approval policy. The approval mode (auto or manual, set by the person in the top bar) decides whether a step needs their approval; the remesh, rigging and animation capabilities are approved by policy in both modes, except that a step with fixed extra credits (for example Tripo rigging or decimation with additional export formats) still waits for the person in manual mode; read the quote in the tool result rather than assuming. It is unrelated to the Agent scope (2D, 3D or auto), which only limits your tools. Never tell the person to switch the Agent scope or the approval mode to obtain a confirmation. Rig Check is a separate zero-credit compatibility check for native Tripo text/image-to-3D sources; it returns a report, not a rigged model. Bang segmentation of a local model needs one reference image from this chat: pass its handle in reference_handles. When several available services can run the step on this model and the person named none, the tool shows an in-chat choice card instead of choosing; call again with offering_id only after the person chose (or use_default_offering=true when they said the default is fine). When the person named a service that cannot take this model, or this call would run a service they did not choose, nothing runs: the result has service_confirmation_required, the reason and the workable options; ask the person, and do not call again without a service or with another one.
fields.chat.tools[name=plan_model_processing].d: Propose an ordered persistent processing plan for a finished 3D model in this session. Prefer this over multiple process_model calls for chains such as mesh segmentation then part completion, or remesh then rigging then animation. The plan service, not Chat, executes steps in order through normal public Tasks, preserving finished steps on failure. Source accepts a platform task ID, @model handle or @selected, optionally a saved model asset ID. Each steps item has capability (remesh, mesh-segmentation, mesh-completion, rigging, animation), optional offering_id and parameters (Offering parameter names from list_offerings; defaults apply). Mesh completion is available only when a compatible Offering is enabled, and accepts only a successfully completed native Tripo Segment task from this same session; Smart Segmentation and Bang segmentation results are not valid sources. Never provide source or consent parameters inside a step. When a later step declares max_source_triangles in list_offerings, choose the earlier remesh step's topology and target face count from its chain_limits[].compatible so the chain fits; a plan over the limit is refused before any step is paid. Animation must follow rigging or start from a rigged source, and needs action_id. Each paid step has its own exact grant under session approval policy. If human approval is needed, the plan waits in the processing panel, where the person confirms each step and its cost; do not claim an in-chat approval card was created. The approval mode (auto or manual, set by the person in the top bar) decides whether a step needs their approval; the remesh, rigging and animation capabilities are approved by policy in both modes, except that a step with fixed extra credits (for example Tripo rigging or decimation with additional export formats) still waits for the person in manual mode; read the quote in the tool result rather than assuming. It is unrelated to the Agent scope (2D, 3D or auto), which only limits your tools. Never tell the person to switch the Agent scope or the approval mode to obtain a confirmation. The result reports plan_id, steps, cost and state, not completed models. Use get_processing_plan to observe; never submit the same chain through process_model as well. Additional declared operations include uv-unwrap, resize, analyze-printability, repair-printability and multi-color-print when an Offering is available. A report or print archive cannot serve as the next model source; use such operations only as a final step. No implicit remesh or auto-size. When several available services can run the step on this model and the person named none, the tool shows an in-chat choice card instead of choosing; call again with offering_id only after the person chose (or use_default_offering=true when they said the default is fine). When the person named a service that cannot take this model, or this call would run a service they did not choose, nothing runs: the result has service_confirmation_required, the reason and the workable options; ask the person, and do not call again without a service or with another one.
fields.chat.tools[name=create_gaussian_splat].d: Generate Gaussian Splat (image to Gaussian Splat) from exactly one explicitly selected owned image. This distinct representation supports preview and raw .splat download, not mesh processing or mesh export. Never substitute a mesh model or silently choose one of several images.

fields.model_delivery.reasons.offering_unavaila: The format conversion service is currently unavailable.
fields.model_delivery.reasons.asset_unreadable: The file cannot be read right now and was not added to the archive.
fields.model_delivery.reasons.not_converted: Not converted yet; fill in the missing formats on the platform to get it.
fields.model_delivery.reasons.converting: Converting; download the archive again when it finishes to include it.
fields.model_delivery.reasons.conversion_incomp: Conversion finished, but no file in this format was produced.
fields.model_delivery.reasons.conversion_failed: The last conversion did not finish; get it again from this model's Formats tab on the platform.
fields.model_delivery.reasons.source_expired: The source model's original task at the provider has passed its retention period, and the available conversion services do not accept a local model file, so it cannot be converted.

offering_texts.仅接受本人同会话已成功的原生 Tripo 分割任务；补全全部部件，不接受文件、普: Only accepts your own successful native Tripo segmentation task from this same session. All parts are completed; files, ordinary modeling tasks, Smart Segmentation outer tasks, and arbitrary part names are not accepted.
offering_texts.仅接受本平台“静态 GLB → glTF”已成功交付的唯一自包含模型。: Only accepts the single self-contained model delivered by a successful "static GLB → glTF" task on this platform.
offering_texts.仅限上传的自包含静态 GLB。STL 仅保留形状，不含材质、贴图、骨骼或动画。: Uploaded self-contained static GLB only. STL keeps shape only, without materials, textures, skeletons, or animations.
offering_texts.全部六种模型格式是必需交付合同，不能减少格式；只允许在保留全部格式时调整顺序。: All six model formats are required by the delivery contract and cannot be reduced. You may only reorder them while keeping all formats.
offering_texts.六边形拼块只支持 6 或 8 mm: Hexagon tiles only support 6 or 8 mm.
offering_texts.几何模型版本独立于纹理模型；默认明确使用最新纹理模型。: The geometry model version is independent of the texture model; the latest texture model is used explicitly by default.
offering_texts.分部件模式生成可单独编辑的分段部件，与纹理、PBR、四边面互斥；耗时较长（进度可: Part-based mode generates separately editable segmented parts; it is mutually exclusive with textures, PBR and quad faces, and takes longer (progress may stay at 99% for a long time).

Choose a preset or enter width x height: each side must be a multiple of 16, at most 3840, with a long-to-short side ratio of at most 3:1. Outputs larger than 2560x1440 are experimental.
offering_texts.是否启用透明/半透明物体识别（如玻璃、水、薄纱）。关闭后速度略快，但透明区域可能: Whether to detect transparent and semi-transparent objects (such as glass, water, and sheer fabric). Turning it off is slightly faster, but transparent areas may be cut out by mistake.
offering_texts.是否对抠图结果做最终精炼。开启后边缘更干净，但处理时间略增: Whether to apply a final refinement to the matting result. When on, edges are cleaner, but processing takes slightly longer.
offering_texts.固定的纹理随机种子可复现相同纹理结果（需与模型随机种子配合）: A fixed texture seed reproduces the same texture (used together with the model seed).
offering_texts.本人已保存或上传的 GLB；在原始资产坐标中以单位矩阵处理。: A GLB you saved or uploaded. It is processed with the identity matrix in the original asset coordinates.

offering_texts.本人拥有、已经成功交付的同模板 Meshy API 设计预览任务。: A Meshy API design preview task of the same template that you own and that has been delivered successfully.
offering_texts.本人拥有且已成功的原生 Tripo Rig v3.0（v3.0-20260909: A native Tripo Rig v3.0 (v3.0-20260909) biped Tripo skeleton rigging task that you own and that has completed successfully. v2.5 rigging, original generated models, other skeletons, and uploaded files are not accepted.
offering_texts.本人拥有且已成功的原生 Tripo 文生或图生 3D 模型；不接收检查报告、上传: A native Tripo text-to-3D or image-to-3D model that you own and that has completed successfully. Check reports, uploaded files, and models from other services are not accepted.
offering_texts.本人拥有的 JPG、PNG 或 WebP 图片，最多 20,000,000 字节: A JPG, PNG, or WebP image that you own, up to 20,000,000 bytes.
A JPG, PNG, or WebP image that you own, up to 20,000,000 bytes. Each side must be at least 32 pixels, and the total pixel count must not exceed 178,956,970.
offering_texts.本人拥有的自包含静态 GLB；不限制生成服务。: A self-contained static GLB that you own, from any generation service.
offering_texts.本人拥有的自包含静态 GLB；不限制生成服务。UV 展开会移除原纹理；仅接收按实: A self-contained static GLB that you own, from any generation service. UV unwrapping removes the original texture. Only models with no more than 40,000 triangles in total across instances are accepted.
offering_texts.本人拥有的自包含静态 GLB；不限制生成服务。候选待真实端点及完整交付验收，当前: A self-contained static GLB that you own, from any generation service. This candidate is pending real-endpoint and full-delivery acceptance and is currently disabled. Repair may remove textures. The report clearly distinguishes repair details reported by the upstream from those not provided.
offering_texts.本人拥有的自包含静态 GLB；不限制生成服务。分析结果不构成打印安全认证。: A self-contained static GLB that you own, from any generation service. The analysis result is not a print safety certification.
offering_texts.本人本会话已成功交付的上述 Rodin 服务；不接受其他服务、加工结果或任意上游: The Rodin service above that you successfully delivered in this session. Other services, processed results, and arbitrary upstream UUIDs are not accepted.
offering_texts.本服务固定交付所列全部附加格式；格式与额外费用在原生处理开始前一并批准。: This service always delivers all the listed additional formats. The formats and extra fees are approved together before native processing starts.
offering_texts.一次转换固定导出全部六种格式（共 1 积分）。Meshy Convert 只返回: One run always exports all six formats (1 credit in total). Meshy Convert returns only the model file of each format, with no separate textures or material library: the OBJ references a material library (such as temp.mtl) that is not provided with the result; its shape and texture coordinates (UVs) are complete, but it has no materials or textures. The task fails if any format fails its check.
offering_texts.本服务固定请求全部六种官方格式；任一格式校验失败则任务失败。: This service always requests all six official formats; if any format fails validation, the task fails.
offering_texts.本服务固定请求并保存全部六种官方格式，其中 3MF 必须显式请求。: This service always requests and saves all six official formats; 3MF must be requested explicitly.
offering_texts.本服务请求全部六种已验证转换格式；每种额外消耗 5 积分，由本次冻结输入的会话批: This service requests all six verified conversion formats; each costs an extra 5 credits and is authorized by the session approval policy for this frozen input.
offering_texts.本服务请求并保存全部六种官方格式。: This service requests and saves all six official formats.
offering_texts.本入口支持至少 0.001 米（1 毫米），这是本入口的有界范围，不是上游公布的: This entry point supports a minimum of 0.001 m (1 mm). This is the entry point's own bound, not a minimum size published by the upstream.
offering_texts.极致 (extreme，最高纹理档，较标准纹理额外 +20 积分): Extreme (highest texture tier, +20 credits over standard texture)
offering_texts.此独立多图端点最高为 2K Ultra；不支持 4K。: This standalone multi-image endpoint supports up to 2K Ultra; 4K is not supported.
offering_texts.生成更高精度的几何细节，仅 Meshy 7 支持且仅在预览阶段生效，额外消耗 5: Generates higher-precision geometric detail; supported by Meshy 7 only and applies only in the preview stage; costs an extra 5 credits
offering_texts.生成更高精度的几何细节，仅 Meshy 7 支持，额外消耗 5 积分: Generates higher-precision geometric detail; supported by Meshy 7 only; costs an extra 5 credits
offering_texts.生成画面比例；模型按像素对齐输出，实际边长以生成图片为准。: Sets the aspect ratio of the image; the model aligns the output to pixels, so the actual side lengths are those of the generated image.
offering_texts.由所选转换项确定。: Determined by the selected conversion options.

offering_texts.第一步粗略识别前景轮廓时使用的图片尺寸。越大越精细但越慢，目前硬件上限 1024: Image size used in the first step to roughly detect the foreground outline. Larger is finer but slower; the current hardware limit is 1024.
offering_texts.第二步精细抠图时使用的图片尺寸。越大细节越好但越慢，目前硬件上限 1024: Image size used in the second step for fine matting. Larger gives better detail but is slower; the current hardware limit is 1024.
offering_texts.粗分割结果的边缘柔化程度。值越大边缘越模糊（过渡更平滑），0 表示不柔化: How much the edges of the coarse segmentation are softened. Higher values blur the edges more (smoother transitions); 0 means no softening.
offering_texts.精炼时对边缘的敏感度（0~1）。值越大保留的细节越多（可能引入噪点），值越小边缘: Edge sensitivity during refinement (0–1). Higher values keep more detail (and may introduce noise); lower values give cleaner edges. Only applies when Mask refinement is on.
offering_texts.精确高度与最长边必须且只能选择一项；本入口不使用自动估算。: Choose exactly one of exact height or longest edge. This entry point does not use automatic estimation.
offering_texts.经平台验证、已归属的自包含静态 GLB，最多 10.48 MB；骨骼、动画及其他: A platform-verified, owned, self-contained static GLB, up to 10.48 MB. Skeletons, animations, and other model formats are not yet available.
offering_texts.背景去除需要符合服务数量约束的已解析输入资产: Background removal requires resolved input assets that satisfy the service's count constraints.

offering_texts.自动缩放至真实世界尺寸（单位：米），仅纹理模型可用: Automatically scales to real-world size (in meters); available for textured models only
offering_texts.自包含静态 GLB；不支持骨骼、动画、压缩、扩展或外部依赖。: Self-contained static GLB. Skeletons, animations, compression, extensions, and external dependencies are not supported.
offering_texts.规范化输入不是 JSON 对象: The normalized input is not a JSON object.
offering_texts.该格式转换服务缺少可核对的成本声明，已停止发送以避免意外扣费: This format conversion service has no verifiable cost declaration, so the request was not sent to avoid unexpected charges.
offering_texts.请求的目标动作时长；实际时长以下载 FBX 的时间轴为准，末帧采样跨度可能短一帧: Requested target animation duration. The actual duration follows the timeline of the downloaded FBX; the last-frame sampling span may be one frame shorter.

offering_texts.选择任何附加转换选项会额外消耗积分；对话里由批准卡片表达同意，工作区「处理」面板: Selecting any additional conversion option consumes extra credits. In chat, consent is given through the approval card; when submitting directly from the workspace Process panel, consent is given with the panel's own checkbox. Actual consumption follows the upstream receipt.
offering_texts.选择画面比例；每个比例都按该比例的最高分辨率出图（低一档的选项会自动改用同比例的: Choose an aspect ratio; each ratio is rendered at its highest resolution (lower-tier options automatically use the highest tier of the same ratio). Only an explicit width x height is sent, and the canvas aligns to its ratio; the 2K/4K tiers where the model decides the ratio are not used (#267).
offering_texts.透明区域为编辑区域；尺寸须与第一张参考图一致。: The transparent area is the editable area; the size must match the first reference image.
offering_texts.附加导出格式费用超出授权上限，已停止执行。: The additional export format fees exceed the authorized limit, so execution was stopped.
offering_texts.附加转换选项的预计额外积分超出本次提交的授权上限，请减少选项后重试: The estimated extra credits for the additional conversion options exceed the authorized limit for this submission. Reduce the options and try again.
offering_texts.需要带贴图、面向 +Z 的人形角色。文件结构通过校验不代表满足人形或朝向条件；不: Requires a textured humanoid character facing +Z. Passing file structure validation does not mean the humanoid or orientation requirements are met; process the model first if they aren't. The model may have at most {limit} triangle faces (a quad counts as two); if it has more, Remesh it to within the limit first.
offering_texts.颜色数量上限，不保证输出达到该种数；实际颜色以下载的 3MF 为准。: Maximum number of colors. The output is not guaranteed to reach that count; the actual colors are those in the downloaded 3MF.
offering_texts.默认三角面兼容最高 8K 纹理；需要四边面时须同时选择兼容的纹理分辨率。: Triangle faces by default, which is compatible with up to 8K texture. If you need quad faces, also choose a compatible texture resolution.
offering_texts.默认优化参考图以改善生成质量；需要严格保留原图外观时可说明理由关闭。: Reference images are optimized by default to improve generation quality. Turn this off, with a stated reason, when the original image's look must be strictly preserved.
offering_texts.默认使用三角面输出。: Triangle output is used by default.
offering_texts.默认使用当前最新纹理模型；Agent 可基于明确需求调整为本端点支持的其他版本并: Defaults to the latest texture model; the Agent may switch to another version supported by this endpoint based on explicit needs and explain why.
offering_texts.默认使用最高 200 万面上限；需要控制面数时使用独立重拓扑。: Defaults to the highest limit of 2 million faces; use a separate remesh when you need to control the face count.
offering_texts.导出分辨率范围为 64–512，默认 512（最高档）；几何来自 512 像素深: Export resolution ranges from 64 to 512, with a default of 512 (the highest); the geometry comes from a 512-pixel depth map, so a finer grid adds no detail.
offering_texts.每次构建只返回所选的一种格式。GLB 可在 3D 舞台预览；ZIP 是上游生成的: Each build returns only the one format you choose. A GLB can be previewed on the 3D stage; the ZIP is the complete file bundle produced upstream and can only be downloaded, not previewed online.
offering_texts.默认使用最高 8K 纹理；可因草稿、文件体积或拓扑兼容需要说明理由降低。: Defaults to the maximum 8K texture. You can lower it, with a stated reason, for drafts, file size, or topology compatibility.
offering_texts.默认使用最高的 extreme 纹理档；官方标称 8K，2026-10-19 实: Defaults to the highest extreme texture tier; officially rated 8K, but on 2026-10-19 the textures of the native GLB and exported formats were measured at 4096×4096. It falls in a different credit tier from detailed.
offering_texts.默认使用此多图端点最高的 2K Ultra 几何；可为草稿降低到 standar: Defaults to 2K Ultra geometry, the highest on this multi-image endpoint. You can lower it to standard for drafts, but this endpoint does not support 4K.
offering_texts.默认值优先保证生成质量和完整交付，不建议更改。Agent 可按需求说明理由并调整: The default prioritizes generation quality and complete delivery, so changing it is not recommended. The Agent may adjust it to any valid value when needed and explain why; required formats, parameter combinations and delivery requirements must still be met.
offering_texts.默认关闭低模优化，保留完整几何细节。: Low-poly optimization is off by default, preserving full geometric detail.
offering_texts.默认关闭重拓扑以保留最高质量的原始几何；需要更规整网格时可说明理由启用。: Remesh is off by default to preserve the highest-quality original geometry. Enable it with a stated reason when you need a cleaner mesh.
offering_texts.默认启用 PBR 材质，并启用纹理。: PBR materials are enabled by default, along with textures.
offering_texts.默认建议三角面：Meshy 的 8K 纹理不支持四边面。: Triangle faces are recommended by default: Meshy's 8K texture does not support quad faces.
offering_texts.默认建议为三角面：Meshy 的 8K 纹理不支持四边面。: The default is triangles: Meshy 8K textures don't support quad faces.
offering_texts.默认建议为上限 300000；需要控制面数时用独立的重拓扑。: The default is the 300000 upper limit; use a separate remesh when you need to control the face count.
offering_texts.默认建议为最高几何分辨率 4K。: The default is the highest geometry resolution, 4K.
offering_texts.默认建议为最高几何分辨率 4K（仅预览阶段上线）。: The default is the highest geometry resolution, 4K (preview stage only).
offering_texts.默认建议为最高分辨率档位 4K，实际宽高随画面比例变化。: The default is the highest resolution tier, 4K; the actual width and height vary with the aspect ratio.
offering_texts.默认建议为最高纹理分辨率 8K。: The default is the highest texture resolution, 8K.
offering_texts.默认建议最高 8K 纹理；关闭纹理时此参数不参与生成，并规范化为 2K 以免产生: 8K texture is recommended by default. When texture is turned off, this parameter is not used for generation and is normalized to 2K to avoid a texture surcharge.
offering_texts.默认生成 PBR 贴图以保留材质细节；仅在不需要物理材质时说明理由关闭。: PBR maps are generated by default to preserve material detail. Turn them off, with a stated reason, only when physically based materials are not needed.
offering_texts.默认生成 UV 展开。: UV unwrapping is generated by default.
offering_texts.默认生成纹理以交付完整外观；仅在明确需要无纹理几何时说明理由关闭。: Texture is generated by default to deliver the complete look. Turn it off, with a stated reason, only when you explicitly need untextured geometry.
offering_texts.默认选择六种官方交叉验证的附加格式；可按需减少，每种转换预计额外消耗 5 积分，: The six officially cross-verified additional formats are selected by default; you can reduce them as needed. Each conversion is expected to cost an extra 5 credits, and you must explicitly approve the frozen input before submitting. GLB has not been cross-verified and is not in this list.
offering_texts.可选。1–4 张同一对象的视角图，只引导纹理，可以与建模参考图不同；首张作为正面: Optional. One to four views of the same object that guide only the texture; they can differ from the modelling references, and the first is the front. Without them the modelling references guide the texture.
offering_texts.官方只为 meshy-6、meshy-7.1 写明 4K/8K 精细化；智能拓扑: Meshy documents 4K/8K refine only for meshy-6 and meshy-7.1, so a Smart Topology preview is refined at 2K.
offering_texts.智能拓扑直接按这个面数生成三角面模型（官方范围 100–30000，默认 150: Smart Topology generates a triangle mesh at this face count directly (official range 100–30000, default 15000); no separate remesh runs.
offering_texts.精细化阶段不发送：官方精细化不接受 meshy-t2.5，省略时沿用预览任务的模: Not sent on refine: Meshy's refine does not accept meshy-t2.5 and, when omitted, uses the preview task's model.

parameters.name: should_remesh

parameters.adjustment_reason: 默认关闭重拓扑以保留最高质量的原始几何；需要更规整网格时可说明理由启用。

parameters.name: should_texture

parameters.adjustment_reason: 默认生成纹理以交付完整外观；仅在明确需要无纹理几何时说明理由关闭。

parameters.name: enable_pbr
parameters.label: PBR 材质
parameters.adjustment_reason: 默认生成 PBR 贴图以保留材质细节；仅在不需要物理材质时说明理由关闭。

parameters.name: texture_resolution
parameters.label: 纹理分辨率
parameters.description: 默认建议最高 8K 纹理；关闭纹理时此参数不参与生成，并规范化为 2K 以免产生纹理加价。
parameters.adjustment_reason: 默认使用最高 8K 纹理；可因草稿、文件体积或拓扑兼容需要说明理由降低。

parameters.name: image_enhancement
parameters.label: 图片增强
parameters.adjustment_reason: 默认优化参考图以改善生成质量；需要严格保留原图外观时可说明理由关闭。
